This document will join covariates from various data sources with the selected multi-scale plots and fine-scale progression transects. 

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Change temp directory to a folder in hard drive
Sys.setenv(TMPDIR = "D:/temp")
terra::terraOptions(tempdir = "D:/temp")
```

# Set-Up

```{r packages, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(spatialEco) #calculate heat load index
library(exactextractr) #extract raster values for shapefiles
library(appeears) #Nasa Earthdata download

conflicted::conflicts_prefer(terra::extract)
conflicted::conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
```

Load Data

```{r load-data}
allplots <- st_read(here("data", "processed", "fuels_analysis.gpkg"),
  layer = "all_plots_selected")

transects <- st_read(here("data", "processed", "fuels_analysis.gpkg"),
  layer = "transects_selected")

state <- st_read("D:/Spatial_Data/States/cb_2018_us_state_20m.shp") %>%
  filter(STUSPS == "CO") %>% 
  st_transform("EPSG:5070") #for joining with Landfire rasters before they are projected to target crs

target_crs <- "EPSG:26913"
```

# Topography

Aspect, elevation, and slope were downloaded from LANDFIRE. Aspect was converted into "northness" which ranges from -1 (perfectly south) to 1 (perfectly north). Heat Load Index (HLI) was calculated using the spatialEco package (https://github.com/jeffreyevans/spatialEco). HLI is a measure of solar radiation which accounts for how slope steepness and aspect influence temperature, ranging from 0 (coolest) to 1 (warmest).

```{r load-topo}
aspect <- rast("D:/Spatial_Data/LANDFIRE/LF2020_Asp_CONUS/Tif/LF2020_Asp_CONUS.tif") %>%
  crop(state) %>%
  mask(state) %>%
  project(target_crs)

#in landfire, flat areas are coded as -1. change to na
aspect[aspect == -1] <- NA

northness <- cos(aspect * pi / 180)

slope <- rast("D:/Spatial_Data/LANDFIRE/LF2020_SlpD_CONUS/Tif/LF2020_SlpD_CONUS.tif") %>%
  crop(state) %>%
  mask(state) %>%
  project(target_crs)

elevation <- rast("D:/Spatial_Data/LANDFIRE/LF2020_Elev_CONUS/Tif/LF2020_Elev_CONUS.tif") %>%
  crop(state) %>%
  mask(state)  

hli <- hli(elevation) %>%
  project(target_crs)

elevation <- elevation %>% 
  project(target_crs) #waited to reproject until after we calculated hli
```

Join topography data to transects.

```{r trans-topo}
north_trans <- extract(northness, transects)
slope_trans <- extract(slope, transects)
elev_trans <- extract(elevation, transects)
hli_trans <- extract(hli, transects)

transects <- transects %>%
  cbind(north_trans, elev_trans, slope_trans, hli_trans) %>%
  select(-starts_with("ID")) %>%
  rename("Northness" = "LF2020_Asp_CONUS",
         "Slope" = "LF2020_SlpD_CONUS",
         "Elevation" = "LF2020_Elev_CONUS",
         "HLI" = "lyr.1")
```

Join topography data to plots.

```{r plots-topo}
north_plots <- extract(northness, allplots, fun = mean)
elev_plots <- extract(elevation, allplots, fun = mean)
slope_plots <- extract(slope, allplots, fun = mean)
hli_plots <- extract(hli, allplots, fun = mean)

allplots <- allplots %>%
  cbind(north_plots, elev_plots, slope_plots, hli_plots) %>%
  select(-starts_with("ID")) %>%
  rename("Northness" = "LF2020_Asp_CONUS",
         "Slope" = "LF2020_SlpD_CONUS",
         "Elevation" = "LF2020_Elev_CONUS",
         "HLI" = "lyr.1")
```

# Fire Weather

As a stand in for individual fire weather variables, we will use the Daily Area Burned, Daily Spread, and a binary "Extremeness" variable based on Daily Area Burned following Balik 2024 definition for the Northwestern Forested Mountains Ecoregion (https://doi.org/10.3389/ffgc.2024.1355361).

This section uses the Day of Burning geopackages created in the previous script.

```{r dob}
doblist <- list.files("C:/Users/Elizabeth Buhr/OneDrive/Documents/fuels-analysis/data/processed/DOB",
                      pattern = "\\.gpkg$", full.names = TRUE)

dob_list <- lapply(doblist, function(f) {
  st_read(f, quiet = TRUE) %>% 
    st_transform(target_crs) %>%
    select(firearea, sprdistm) #Daily Area Burned and Unidirectional Spread
})

names(dob_list) <- sub("_DOB$", "", tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(doblist)))

join_dob <- function(x, largest = FALSE) {
  x %>%
    mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
    split(.$Event_ID) %>%
    imap_dfr(function(feat, fire) {
      d <- dob_list[[fire]]                      # exact match, no grep()
      if (is.null(d)) return(feat)               # fire with no DOB file -> NAs
      st_join(feat, d, join = st_intersects, largest = largest)
    }) %>%
    distinct(row_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%       # guards against points on a shared polygon edge
    arrange(row_id) %>%
    select(-row_id) %>%
    rename(Daily_Area = firearea,
           Daily_Spread = sprdistm)
}

transects <- transects %>%
  join_dob() %>%
  mutate(Extreme = Daily_Area > 4127)
allplots <- allplots %>%
  join_dob(largest = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Extreme = Daily_Area > 4127)
```

# Climate

Climate data was obtained from PRISM at a 800-m resolution. We considered annual total precipitation, mean temperature, minimum vapor pressure deficit (min VPD), and maximum vapor pressure deficit (max VPD). 

For each climate variable, we calculated z-scores comparing the fire year to the 30-year reference period preceding the fire. Z-scores are calculated as *z = (x − μ)/σ* where X = the fire year mean, μ = the reference period mean, and σ = the reference period standard deviation. This returns the distance in standard deviations away from reference conditions.

```{r prism}
prism_base <- "D:/Spatial_Data/PRISM"
vars <- c("PPT", "TMEAN", "VPDMIN", "VPDMAX")

prism_file <- function(v, yr) {
  nm <- paste0("prism_", tolower(v), "_us_30s_", yr)
  file.path(prism_base, v, nm, paste0(nm, ".bil"))
}

# Baseline = (yr-30):(yr-1); comparison = yr. Returns z
anomaly_stack <- function(v, yr, e) {
  base_files <- vapply((yr - 30):(yr - 1), \(y) prism_file(v, y), character(1))
  stopifnot(all(file.exists(c(base_files, prism_file(v, yr)))))

  base_r <- crop(rast(base_files), e)
  yr_r   <- crop(rast(prism_file(v, yr)), e)

  norm <- mean(base_r, na.rm = TRUE)
  sdev <- stdev(base_r, pop = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)  # sample SD (n-1); terra defaults to pop = TRUE

  out <- c((yr_r - norm) / sdev)
  names(out) <- paste0(v, "_z")
  out
}

join_prism <- function(x, type = c("points", "polygons"), target_crs) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  out <- NULL

  for (yr in sort(unique(x$Fire_Year))) {
    x_yr  <- x[x$Fire_Year == yr, ]
    x_prj <- st_transform(x_yr, 4269)            # PRISM is NAD83 geographic

    e <- ext(vect(x_prj))
    e <- ext(e[1] - 0.1, e[2] + 0.1, e[3] - 0.1, e[4] + 0.1)  # small buffer, degrees

    a <- do.call(c, lapply(vars, anomaly_stack, yr = yr, e = e))

    vals <- if (type == "points") {
      terra::extract(a, vect(x_prj), ID = FALSE)
    } else {
      exact_extract(a, x_prj, fun = "mean", progress = FALSE)
    }
    names(vals) <- names(a)

    out <- bind_rows(out, bind_cols(x_yr, vals))
  }

  st_transform(out, target_crs)
}

transects <- join_prism(transects, "points",   target_crs)
allplots  <- join_prism(allplots,  "polygons", target_crs)

transects <- transects %>%
  rename(Ppt_Z = PPT_z,
         Tmean_Z = TMEAN_z,
         Vpdmin_Z = VPDMIN_z,
         Vpdmax_Z = VPDMAX_z)
allplots <- allplots %>%
  rename(Ppt_Z = PPT_z,
         Tmean_Z = TMEAN_z,
         Vpdmin_Z = VPDMIN_z,
         Vpdmax_Z = VPDMAX_z)
```

# Treatment Characteristics

- Treatment type (Thinning (No Removal), Thinning (With Removal), Broadcast Burning, Previous Wildfire (with prev wildfire severity))
- Years Since Treatment (Age)
- Number of Treatments
- Treatment Size

For Plots
- Treatment Extent

```{r}
treats <- st_read("data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg", layer = "treatments")

treats <- treats %>%
  mutate(Trt_Type = case_when(
    MGT_TYPE == "Wildfire" ~ "Wildfire",
    ACTIVITY %in% c("Removal", "Pile Burn") ~ "Removal",
    ACTIVITY %in% "Broadcast Burn" ~ "Broadcast Burn",
    ACTIVITY %in% c("Pile Fuels", "Mastication", "Manual", "Mulching", "Mechanical", "Lop and Scatter", "Chemical") ~ "Rearrangement"
  ))
```

Join Transects

```{r}
# Add a unique identifier to your transects to track individual points
transects <- transects %>% 
  mutate(point_id = row_number())

# Perform the spatial intersection (points x polygons)
# left = TRUE ensures we keep all transect points, even if they have NO treatments
joined_raw <- st_join(transects, treats, join = st_intersects, left = TRUE)

# Clean up the geometry and process the overlaps
# We drop geometry temporarily to make the group/summarize operations fast on RAM
treatment_summary <- joined_raw %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  
  # Group by our unique point ID
  group_by(point_id) %>%
  
  # Calculate the metrics per point
  mutate(
    # Count how many treatments hit this point (ignores NA if no treatment matched)
    Trt_Count = sum(!is.na(YEAR_COMP)),
    
    # Calculate the earliest treatment year for TCC
    # If COUNT is 0, min() returns Inf, so we correct it back to NA
    TCC_Year = ifelse(Trt_Count > 0, min(YEAR_COMP, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
    
    Trt_Age = ifelse(Trt_Count > 0, (Fire_Year - YEAR_COMP), NA_real_)
      ) %>%
  
  # Arrange by YEAR_COMP (descending) so the latest year is always on top (Row 1)
  # using NA_real_ sort behavior to keep untreated points accessible
  arrange(desc(YEAR_COMP), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  
  # Keep only the top row per point (the latest treatment)
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # Keep only our point key, the count, and the specific variables you requested
  select(point_id, Trt_Count, YEAR_COMP, TCC_Year, Trt_Age, Trt_Type, OBJECTID) %>%
  rename(Trt_Year = YEAR_COMP, Trt_ID = OBJECTID)

# Join the processed attributes back to your original spatial transect object
transects <- transects %>%
  left_join(treatment_summary, by = "point_id") %>%
  select(-point_id) # Drop the temporary ID tracking column
```

Join Plots

```{r}
# Add structural tracking columns to the plots base
allplots_base <- allplots %>%
  mutate(
    plot_id = row_number(),
    total_plot_area = as.numeric(st_area(.))
  )

# Add a row identifier to treatments to act as a proxy tracker for individual polygons
treats_prep <- treats %>%
  mutate(treatment_id = row_number())

# Compute Total Treated Extent AND Count of Overlaps
# We use st_intersection with the raw treats layer to find out how many shapes hit each plot area
plots_joined_raw <- st_intersection(allplots_base %>% select(plot_id, total_plot_area, Fire_Year), treats_prep) %>%
  mutate(slice_area = as.numeric(st_area(.))) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

# Calculate total distinct footprints without counting overlaps
treated_footprint <- st_intersection(allplots_base %>% select(plot_id), st_union(treats)) %>%
  mutate(treated_area_no_overlap = as.numeric(st_area(.))) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(plot_id, treated_area_no_overlap)

# Calculate the actual raw count of treatments that touched each plot boundary
overlap_counts <- plots_joined_raw %>%
  group_by(plot_id) %>%
  summarize(
    # How many unique treatment shapes physically intersected this plot footprint?
    Trt_Count = n_distinct(treatment_id),
    # What is the minimum treatment year intersecting this plot footprint?
    TCC_Year = min(YEAR_COMP),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Compute Categorical Proportions and Weighted Means
# Process continuous variables (Area-Weighted Means for Trt_Year and Age)
continuous_summary <- plots_joined_raw %>%
  group_by(plot_id) %>%
  summarize(
    # Weight the completion year by the size of the slice it covers inside the plot
    Trt_Year = sum(YEAR_COMP * slice_area) / sum(slice_area),
    Trt_Age = first(Fire_Year) - Trt_Year,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Process categorical variables (Proportions of Plot Area)
# Dissolve treatment polygons by type first, so overlapping polygons
# of the same TRT_TYPE don't get double-counted
treats_by_type <- treats_prep %>%
  group_by(Trt_Type) %>%
  summarize(.groups = "drop")

# Intersect plots with the dissolved-by-type layer
plots_by_type <- st_intersection(
  allplots_base %>% select(plot_id, total_plot_area),
  treats_by_type
) %>%
  mutate(slice_area = as.numeric(st_area(.))) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

# Now proportions per type are safe to sum directly (no overlap within a type)
categorical_summary <- plots_by_type %>%
  group_by(plot_id, Trt_Type) %>%
  summarize(slice_sum = sum(slice_area), total_plot_area = first(total_plot_area), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(prop = slice_sum / total_plot_area) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = plot_id,
    names_from = Trt_Type,
    values_from = prop,
    values_fill = 0,
    names_prefix = "Prop_"
  )

# Combine everything back onto the original plot spatial data frame
allplots_final <- allplots_base %>%
  left_join(treated_footprint, by = "plot_id") %>%
  left_join(overlap_counts, by = "plot_id") %>%
  left_join(continuous_summary, by = "plot_id") %>%
  left_join(categorical_summary, by = "plot_id") %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert metrics to structural zeros/defaults if the plot never touched a treatment
    Prop_Treated = coalesce(treated_area_no_overlap / total_plot_area, 0),
    Trt_Count = coalesce(Trt_Count, 0),
    # Safety Check: If TOTAL_COUNT is 0, make sure TCC_Year is NA, not Inf
    TCC_Year = ifelse(Trt_Count > 0, TCC_Year, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  # Clean up structural calculation columns and replace missing join values with 0
  select(-plot_id, -total_plot_area, -treated_area_no_overlap) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Prop_"), ~coalesce(., 0))) 

allplots <- allplots_final
```

# Pre-Fire Fuels

Pre-fire vegetation is represented by the 2001 Landfire Existing Vegetation Type Physiognomic Group. Pre-fire fuels are represented by NLCD Annual Tree Canopy Cover for the year prior to treatment.

## EVT

```{r}
evt <- rast("D:/Spatial_Data/LANDFIRE/US_105_EVT_20250916_2001/US_105_EVT_20250916/US_105_EVT/Tif/us_105evt.tif") %>%
  crop(state) %>%
  mask(state) %>%
  project(target_crs)

#Using physiognomy groups
activeCat(evt) <- "SYSTMGRPPH"
```

Join transects

```{r}
evt_trans <- extract(evt, transects)

transects <- transects %>%
  cbind(evt_trans) %>%
  select(-starts_with("ID")) %>%
  rename("EVT" = "SYSTMGRPPH")
```

Join Plots

```{r}
# ID -> physiognomy lookup
cats_tbl   <- cats(evt)[[1]]
active_col <- names(cats_tbl)[activeCat(evt) + 1]
id_col     <- names(cats_tbl)[1]

lookup <- cats_tbl %>%
  select(value = all_of(id_col), group = all_of(active_col)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    clean = paste0("Prop_", (gsub("^_|_$", "", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", group))))
  )

# Exact-area fraction of each EVT value within each plot 
evt_frac <- exact_extract(
  evt,
  allplots,
  fun = "frac",
  append_cols = "Plot_ID",
  progress = FALSE
)

# Sum EVT fractions into physiognomy groups, one column per group
evt_prop <- evt_frac %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("frac_"),
               names_to = "value", names_prefix = "frac_",
               values_to = "frac") %>%
  mutate(value = as.numeric(value)) %>%
  left_join(lookup, by = "value") %>%
  group_by(Plot_ID, clean) %>%
  summarise(prop = sum(frac, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = clean, values_from = prop, values_fill = 0) %>%
  select(Plot_ID, Prop_Conifer, Prop_Conifer_Hardwood, Prop_Hardwood, Prop_Grassland, Prop_Shrubland, Prop_Riparian, Prop_Exotic_Herbaceous)
  # dropping some groups with very low cover

# Join back onto plots
allplots <- allplots %>%
  left_join(evt_prop, by = "Plot_ID") 
```

## Canopy Cover

We will need to add a temporary column to plots with the year we want TCC (year prior to earliest treatment, or year prior to fire for controls).

```{r}
tcc_base_dir <- "D:/Spatial_Data/NLCD"

# Search recursively to find all .tif files within the subfolders
all_tcc_files <- list.files(
  path = tcc_base_dir, 
  pattern = "\\.tif$", 
  recursive = TRUE, 
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Extract the 4-digit year from the filename using a regular expression
tcc_years <- str_extract(basename(all_tcc_files), "(19|20)\\d{2}(?=0101)")

# Build a clean named vector where the names are the years and values are paths
tcc_file_map <- all_tcc_files
names(tcc_file_map) <- tcc_years

# Quick check: print years found
print(names(tcc_file_map))
```

Join transects

```{r}
# 1. Calculate the target year per transect row
transects_prep <- transects %>%
  mutate(
    # Handle both your point datasets (use YEAR_COMP if it exists, otherwise default to fire year)
    base_year = if_all(any_of("TCC_Year"), ~ !is.na(.)) %>% 
                ifelse(coalesce(TCC_Year, Fire_Year), Fire_Year),
                
    # If treated, use YEAR_COMP - 1 (or your explicit TCC_Year - 1 variable). Otherwise fire year - 1.
    target_tcc_year = as.character(base_year - 1),
    row_id = row_number()
  )

# Match CRS to the first available TCC raster
first_tcc_raster <- rast(tcc_file_map[1])
transects_proj <- st_transform(transects_prep, crs(first_tcc_raster))

# 2. Extract values by looping over each unique target year group
transects_with_tcc <- transects_proj %>%
  split(.$target_tcc_year) %>%
  imap_dfr(function(pts, yr) {
    
    # Check if we actually have a raster file for that year
    if (!yr %in% names(tcc_file_map)) {
      warning(paste("No NLCD TCC raster available for year:", yr))
      pts$TCC <- NA_real_
      return(pts)
    }
    
    # Load annual raster pointer
    r_tcc <- rast(tcc_file_map[[yr]])
    
    # Extract points values
    extracted <- terra::extract(r_tcc, vect(pts), ID = FALSE)
    pts$TCC <- extracted[[1]]
    return(pts)
  }) %>%
  arrange(row_id) %>%
  select(-row_id, -base_year, -target_tcc_year)

# Return to your working target CRS
transects <- st_transform(transects_with_tcc, target_crs) %>%
  select(-TCC_Year)
```

Join plots

```{r}
# 1. Calculate target year for plots
allplots_prep <- allplots %>%
  mutate(
    # If TOTAL_COUNT > 0, we assume treated. Use mean_YEAR_COMP or your target year calculation.
    base_year = if_all(any_of("TCC_Year"), ~ !is.na(.)) %>% 
                ifelse(coalesce(as.integer(TCC_Year), Fire_Year), Fire_Year),
    target_tcc_year = as.character(base_year - 1),
    row_id = row_number()
  )

# Match CRS
allplots_proj <- st_transform(allplots_prep, crs(first_tcc_raster))

# 2. Extract polygon spatial means grouped by year
allplots_with_tcc <- allplots_proj %>%
  split(.$target_tcc_year) %>%
  imap_dfr(function(polys, yr) {
    
    if (!yr %in% names(tcc_file_map)) {
      warning(paste("No NLCD TCC raster available for year:", yr))
      polys$TCC <- NA_real_
      return(polys)
    }
    
    r_tcc <- rast(tcc_file_map[[yr]])
    
    # Extract spatial average across each plot polygon boundary
    extracted <- terra::extract(r_tcc, vect(polys), fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE, ID = FALSE)
    polys$TCC <- extracted[[1]]
    return(polys)
  }) %>%
  arrange(row_id) %>%
  select(-row_id, -base_year, -target_tcc_year)

# Return to target CRS
allplots <- st_transform(allplots_with_tcc, target_crs) %>%
  select(-TCC_Year)
```


# Response Variable

We found RdNBR following Parks GEE methods. RdNBR is used as a continuous value for transect points and a mean for plots. Categorical severity (L/M/H) is based on Parks et al. 2018 (https://doi.org/10.3390/rs10060879) for RdNBR without offset: "Threshold values for each fire severity metric corresponding to low (CBI = 0–1.24), moderate (CBI = 1.25–2.25), and high severity (CBI = 2.25–3)."

```{r}
rdnbrlist <- list.files(path = "data/processed/GEE/FireSeverity/RdNBR", pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
rdnbr_rast <- lapply(rdnbrlist, terra::rast)

# Extract fire name/ID from filenames to use as a matching key
fire_names <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(rdnbrlist))
names(rdnbr_rast) <- fire_names
```

Join transects

```{r}
# Reproject transects to match raster CRS
transects_proj <- st_transform(transects, crs(rdnbr_rast[[1]]))

# Extract rdnbr for each transect point from its matching raster
# This loops over each unique fire, extracts from the right raster, then recombines

transects <- transects_proj %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%  # preserve original order
  split(.$Event_ID) %>%              
  imap_dfr(function(pts, fire) {
    
    # Find the matching raster (partial match in case names aren't exact)
    rast_match <- rdnbr_rast[[grep(fire, names(rdnbr_rast), value = TRUE)[1]]]
    
    if (is.null(rast_match)) {
      warning(paste("No matching raster for fire:", fire))
      return(pts %>% mutate(RdNBR = NA))
    }
    
    # Extract values
    extracted <- terra::extract(rast_match, vect(pts))
    pts <- pts %>% mutate(RdNBR = extracted[, 2])  # column 1 is ID, column 2 is the raster value
    return(pts)
    
  }) %>%
  arrange(row_id) %>%   # restore original order
  select(-row_id)

#Sort start of transects into L/M/H based on average severity of first 5 points
transects <- transects %>%
  group_by(Transect_ID) %>% 
mutate(
    start_value = mean(RdNBR[Point_Num %in% 1:5], na.rm = TRUE),
    Starting_Sev = case_when(
      start_value <= 338              ~ "Low",
      start_value >= 339 & start_value <= 726 ~ "Moderate",
      start_value >= 727              ~ "High",
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-start_value)

#Reproject transects back to target crs
transects <- st_transform(transects, target_crs)
```

Join plots

```{r}
# Reproject plots to match raster CRS
allplots_proj <- st_transform(allplots, crs(rdnbr_rast[[1]]))

# Loop through each unique fire, extract pixel values, and calculate thresholds
allplots_with_rdnbr <- allplots_proj %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%  # Track original row order
  split(.$Event_ID) %>%              # Split into a list of datasets by Fire ID
  imap_dfr(function(polys, fire) {
    
    # Find the matching raster (partial match in case names aren't exact)
    rast_match <- rdnbr_rast[[grep(fire, names(rdnbr_rast), value = TRUE)[1]]]
    
    if (is.null(rast_match)) {
      warning(paste("No matching raster for fire:", fire))
      polys$mean_rdnbr <- NA_real_
      polys$prop_high_sev <- NA_real_
      polys$prop_mod_high_sev <- NA_real_
      return(polys)
    }
    
    # Convert polygons to SpatVector for terra
    v_polys <- vect(polys)
    
    # Extract ALL underlying pixels per polygon circle. 
    # Setting ID = TRUE allows us to keep track of which pixels belong to which plot.
    extracted_pixels <- terra::extract(rast_match, v_polys, ID = TRUE)
    
    # Identify the name of the data column (it matches the raster file name)
    rdnbr_col_name <- names(extracted_pixels)[2]
    
    # Calculate the summaries for each plot in this fire subset
    rdnbr_summary <- extracted_pixels %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[rdnbr_col_name]])) %>%
      group_by(ID) %>%
      summarize(
        # 1. Continuous Mean
        Mean_RdNBR = mean(.data[[rdnbr_col_name]]),
        
        # 2. Proportion of High Severity (RdNBR >= 727)
        Prop_High_Sev = sum(.data[[rdnbr_col_name]] >= 727) / n(),
        
        # 3. Proportion of Moderate to High Severity (RdNBR >= 339 & RdNBR <= 726)
        Prop_Mod_High_Sev = sum(.data[[rdnbr_col_name]] >= 339 & .data[[rdnbr_col_name]] <= 726) / n(),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    
    # Bind the summarized metrics back onto the spatial plot rows
    # The 'ID' column generated by terra perfectly matches the row index of v_polys
    polys_summarized <- polys %>%
      mutate(ID = row_number()) %>%
      left_join(rdnbr_summary, by = "ID") %>%
      select(-ID)
    
    return(polys_summarized)
    
  }) %>%
  arrange(row_id) %>%   # Reorder rows back to the exact input state
  select(-row_id)

# Project your plots back to your target project CRS
allplots <- st_transform(allplots_with_rdnbr, target_crs)
```

```{r}
st_write(
  obj = transects,
  dsn = "data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg",
  layer = "transectsDS",
  driver = "GPKG",
  delete_layer= TRUE
)

st_write(
  obj = allplots,
  dsn = "data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg",
  layer = "allplotsDS",
  driver = "GPKG",
  delete_layer= TRUE
)
```
